description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the LocalizationDao in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test cases for various DAO methods related to localization, language management, translation normalization, group management, error handling, and import errors.

classes.name: LocalizationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizationDao related functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, populates test data from fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests the searchLanguages method with various filter parameters.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test case data from a YAML file for parameters.

methods.name: searchLanguagesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data for searchLanguages test cases.

methods.name: testGetLanguagesCount
methods.description: Tests the counting of languages with filters.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a language by ID.

methods.name: testSaveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new language object.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Tests retrieval and normalization of translation data.

methods.name: testGetTranslationsCount
methods.description: Tests counting translations with various filters.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Tests counting of translation groups based on filters.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of error entities by error name.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of group entities by name.

methods.name: testGetLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupID
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language string by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: testGetLangStringById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language string by ID.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Tests clearing import errors for specific language strings.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorList
methods.description: Tests fetching list of import errors for a language.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorCount
methods.description: Tests counting import errors for a specified language.
